nodes.description: SafeMath library function mul(uint256 a, uint256 b) returning a*b with an overflow require(c/a==b) check.
SafeMath library function div(uint256 a, uint256 b) requiring b>0 and returning a/b.
SafeMath library function divCeil(uint256 a, uint256 b) returning the ceiling of a/b.
SafeMath library function sub(uint256 a, uint256 b) requiring b<=a and returning a-b.
SafeMath library function add(uint256 a, uint256 b) computing c=a+b and requiring c>=a.
SafeMath library function sqrt(uint256 x) computing the integer square root with a division loop.
Public view function computing a user's staked base and quote balances from the DODO mine LP tokens and LP total supplies.
External view function returning a user's staked plus wallet LP base and quote balances.
External view interface function of IDODO returning baseTarget and quoteTarget.
External view interface function of IDODO returning a user's LP base balance.
External view interface function of IDODO returning a user's LP quote balance.
External view ERC20 interface function returning the total token supply.
External view interface function of IDODOMine returning a user's staked LP token balance.
Raw multiplication c = a * b performed in SafeMath.mul before the overflow require check.
Raw division a / b in SafeMath.div, protected only by require(b > 0).
Raw divisions x / 2 and x / z inside the SafeMath.sqrt loop.
Raw subtraction and multiplication a - quotient * b inside SafeMath.divCeil.
Raw subtraction a - b in SafeMath.sub, protected only by require(b <= a).
Raw addition c = a + b in SafeMath.add before the overflow require check.
Division baseTarget.mul(baseLpBalance).div(baseLpTotalSupply) where the divisor comes from an externally controlled LP token totalSupply and may be zero.
Division quoteTarget.mul(quoteLpBalance).div(quoteLpTotalSupply) where the divisor comes from an externally controlled LP token totalSupply and may be zero.
External call IDODO(_dodo).getExpectedTarget() against a caller-supplied _dodo address, an untrusted contract that can reenter or return arbitrary values.
External calls IDODOMine(_dodoMine).getUserLpBalance(lpToken, _user) against a caller-supplied _dodoMine address.
External calls IERC20(baseLpToken).totalSupply() and IERC20(quoteLpToken).totalSupply() on token addresses returned by the untrusted DODO contract.
External calls IDODO(_dodo).getLpBaseBalance(_user) and getLpQuoteBalance(_user) against the caller-supplied _dodo address.
Additions combining externally returned staked balances with wallet LP balances in getUserTotalBalance.
Input parameter _dodoMine of getUserStakedBalance, the mine contract address supplied by the caller.
Input parameter _dodo of getUserStakedBalance, the DODO pool address supplied by the caller.
Input parameter _user of getUserStakedBalance, the user whose staked balance is queried.
Local variable baseLpToken holding IDODO(_dodo)._BASE_CAPITAL_TOKEN_().
Local variable quoteLpToken holding IDODO(_dodo)._QUOTE_CAPITAL_TOKEN_().
Local variable baseLpBalance holding the user's staked base LP amount from the mine.
Local variable quoteLpBalance holding the user's staked quote LP amount from the mine.
Local variable baseLpTotalSupply holding IERC20(baseLpToken).totalSupply(), used as a divisor.
Local variable quoteLpTotalSupply holding IERC20(quoteLpToken).totalSupply(), used as a divisor.
Local variable baseTarget returned by IDODO(_dodo).getExpectedTarget().
Local variable quoteTarget returned by IDODO(_dodo).getExpectedTarget().
Local/return variable baseBalance computed as baseTarget.mul(baseLpBalance).div(baseLpTotalSupply).
Local/return variable quoteBalance computed as quoteTarget.mul(quoteLpBalance).div(quoteLpTotalSupply).
Input parameter _dodoMine of getUserTotalBalance, forwarded to getUserStakedBalance.
Input parameter _dodo of getUserTotalBalance, forwarded to getUserStakedBalance and balance queries.
Input parameter _user of getUserTotalBalance, the user whose total balance is queried.
Local variable stakedBase returned by getUserStakedBalance.
Local variable stakedQuote returned by getUserStakedBalance.
Local/return variable baseBalance of getUserTotalBalance, the sum of wallet and staked base LP.
Local/return variable quoteBalance of getUserTotalBalance, the sum of wallet and staked quote LP.

edges.reason: Parameter _dodoMine is consumed only inside getUserStakedBalance.
Parameter _dodo is consumed only inside getUserStakedBalance.
Parameter _user is consumed only inside getUserStakedBalance.
Parameter _dodoMine flows into getUserTotalBalance.
Parameter _dodo flows into getUserTotalBalance.
Parameter _user flows into getUserTotalBalance.
_dodo is used to fetch the base LP token address via IDODO(_dodo)._BASE_CAPITAL_TOKEN_().
_dodo is used to fetch the quote LP token address via IDODO(_dodo)._QUOTE_CAPITAL_TOKEN_().
_dodoMine is the target contract of the getUserLpBalance external calls.
baseLpToken is passed as the LP token argument of getUserLpBalance to produce baseLpBalance.
quoteLpToken is passed as the LP token argument of getUserLpBalance to produce quoteLpBalance.
_user is the user argument of the getUserLpBalance call that yields baseLpBalance.
_user is the user argument of the getUserLpBalance call that yields quoteLpBalance.
baseLpToken is the token whose totalSupply() becomes baseLpTotalSupply.
quoteLpToken is the token whose totalSupply() becomes quoteLpTotalSupply.
baseTarget is returned by the untrusted external call IDODO(_dodo).getExpectedTarget().
quoteTarget is returned by the untrusted external call IDODO(_dodo).getExpectedTarget().
baseLpBalance is returned by the untrusted external call IDODOMine(_dodoMine).getUserLpBalance().
quoteLpBalance is returned by the untrusted external call IDODOMine(_dodoMine).getUserLpBalance().
baseLpTotalSupply is returned by the untrusted external call IERC20(baseLpToken).totalSupply().
quoteLpTotalSupply is returned by the untrusted external call IERC20(quoteLpToken).totalSupply().
baseLpTotalSupply is the divisor of the base balance division and can be zero for the attacker-controlled LP token.
quoteLpTotalSupply is the divisor of the quote balance division and can be zero for the attacker-controlled LP token.
The base division produces the returned baseBalance.
The quote division produces the returned quoteBalance.
baseTarget is multiplied by baseLpBalance when computing baseBalance.
baseLpBalance is the numerator component of baseBalance.
quoteTarget is multiplied by quoteLpBalance when computing quoteBalance.
quoteLpBalance is the numerator component of quoteBalance.
getUserStakedBalance performs the external getExpectedTarget call on the caller-supplied pool address.
getUserStakedBalance performs external getUserLpBalance calls on the caller-supplied mine address.
getUserStakedBalance performs external totalSupply calls on the returned LP token addresses.
getUserTotalBalance calls getUserStakedBalance to obtain staked balances.
The returned staked base balance becomes stakedBase in the caller.
The returned staked quote balance becomes stakedQuote in the caller.
getUserTotalBalance performs external getLpBaseBalance and getLpQuoteBalance calls on the caller-supplied pool address.
_dodo is the target address of the LP balance external calls.
_user is the account argument of the LP balance external calls.
The wallet base LP balance comes from the untrusted external call and feeds baseBalance.
The wallet quote LP balance comes from the untrusted external call and feeds quoteBalance.
stakedBase is added to the wallet balance in an unchecked-sum context.
stakedQuote is added to the wallet balance in an unchecked-sum context.
The addition yields the returned baseBalance.
The addition yields the returned quoteBalance.
getUserTotalBalance performs the additions of staked and wallet LP balances.
SafeMath.mul executes the raw multiplication before the overflow check.
SafeMath.div executes the raw division after requiring a non-zero divisor.
SafeMath.sqrt performs unchecked divisions inside its loop.
SafeMath.divCeil performs a raw subtraction and multiplication of the remainder.
SafeMath.sub executes the raw subtraction guarded by require(b <= a).
SafeMath.add executes the raw addition before the overflow check.
SafeMath.divCeil internally reuses SafeMath.div.
External call into the untrusted IDODO implementation of getExpectedTarget, whose address is caller supplied.
External call into the untrusted IDODOMine implementation of getUserLpBalance, whose address is caller supplied.
External call into the untrusted IERC20 implementation of totalSupply, whose address is taken from the untrusted pool.
External call into the untrusted IDODO implementation of getLpBaseBalance.
External call into the untrusted IDODO implementation of getLpQuoteBalance.
